name: Shin-Koenji
tagline: Shinjuku in 12 minutes and Shibuya in 22 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Suginami City, served by Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 31 minutes to Otemachi, 12 minutes to Shinjuku, 22 minutes to Shibuya and 43 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 43 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 6.7 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 43 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 38 m to 44.7 m, a difference of 6.7 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 2 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 23 clinics and 16 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 北條病院, about 646 m away and 静山会清川病院, about 781 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line. Only one line runs here, so when it stops you will be walking to a station on another line. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 32.

rentRange.note: One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000, 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000, 1LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 2LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Koenji is ahead on the number of lines, but Shin-Koenji is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: 828 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi 3 minutes sooner than Shin-Koenji.

neighbours.lead: Higashi-Koenji is ahead on how close the centre is, but Shin-Koenji is ahead on the number of medical facilities and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: 881 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Shin-Koenji. One-room rents run about ¥6,000 higher.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 9 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the 青梅街道 (2 lanes each way) runs 13 m away. Morning and evening, the cars are audible indoors serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make: 青梅街道 runs 13 m away.
